item.title: Product Hunt Daily | 2026-09-09

1. Switch

Tagline: Bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams & Discord
Description: Switch brings AI agents into the collaboration tools your team already uses. Agents join as named participants in your Slack, Teams, Discord, or Telegram channels, sharing the same context and history as your team. Connect an agent once and use it across projects. Each room carries its own context, participants, and rules. Works with Claude Code, OpenAI, Google ADK, LangChain, and more. Open source, self-hostable, running in minutes.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: AI agents, collaboration tools, Slack integration, Teams integration, Discord integration, Telegram integration, context-aware agents, multi-platform AI, open source, self-hostable, AI workspace, team collaboration, agent participants, shared context, cross-project agents

Here, claims don’t count just because they’re written on a product page. They have to survive scrutiny and be proven.
